name: Dust
insight: Founded by ex-OpenAI engineer Stanislas Polu; raised a $40M Series B led by Sequoia and Abstract in May 2026.
tagline: Enterprise platform for building and sharing custom AI agents on company knowledge.
description: An enterprise AI platform where teams build custom agents over shared company knowledge and reuse them org-wide. Connectors pull in Slack, Notion, Google Drive, and other workspace tools; each agent can run on a choice of frontier models. Used by 3,000+ organizations with over 300,000 agents deployed.

modelSupport.notes: Pick the model per agent across major frontier providers.

edge: Org-wide 'multiplayer' AI over shared company knowledge — agents are built once and reused across teams, not siloed per user.
cons: No free tier beyond a 14-day trial
Per-seat cost scales with org size

references.title: Sequoia backs AI agents scaleup Dust in $40m Series B
Dust raises $40M to make AI multiplayer inside the enterprise
